purpose: Entry point for the exhaustive, privacy-sanitized iCloud mail analysis. Raw mail remains local; this directory contains only durable derived context and evidence-model metadata.

artifacts.purpose: Coverage, evidence policy, privacy rules, completion boundary.
Communication style, reply behavior, work style, organization/memory patterns.
Education, employment, applications/interviews, career center of gravity.
Skyrim/modding, gaming, reading/fanfiction, brick collecting, research platforms, AI/dev tools, devices.
Privacy-preserving personal and institutional relationship graph.
Unresolved-commitment patterns, administrative friction, deterministic automation opportunities.
Cross-domain behavioral workflow synthesis without diagnostic/personality labeling.
Housing, meal-convenience, cooking/DIY, vehicle, and household-planning patterns.
Message-volume evolution and recency/evidence weighting rules.
Aggregate attachment inventory and safe future extraction plan.
Unresolved facts, version conflicts, and questions that must not be guessed.

promotion_model.rule: Only high-confidence, useful, non-sensitive conclusions are promoted to canonical user context. Rich historical/evidence analysis remains supporting context and is not automatically injected wholesale.

privacy_boundary: No raw message bodies, email addresses, phone numbers, exact addresses, account identifiers, credentials/security artifacts, payment identifiers, health details, intimate correspondence, or unnecessary third-party PII are stored in these Git-tracked analysis files.
completion_boundary: The indexed email-message text is exhausted for this pass. The 231 metadata-only attachment bodies remain a separate future corpus and are explicitly not treated as read.
